detail.longDescription: I just released the first beta version of my summer side-project: labmon, a monitoring and logging stack meant to be used in labs. https:// marolleau.me/posts/labmon-beta/ I hope that it would be helpful to experimentalists, and maybe one day contribute to the effort of making science more transparent and reproducible. Link to the repo: https:// github.com/quentinmarolleau/la bmon # opensource # python # physics # labautomation # LabSoftware # monitoring
